name: Prisma Dual Cleavers
tradeable: unranked only, no Forma or Catalyst

groups.activity: crack Void Relics, trade Prime parts for Ducats
groups.mode: squad of four for more reward picks

rows.label: Ducats
rows.note: trade Prime parts and blueprints at any Relay Ducat Kiosk except Maroo's Bazaar

conditions: The kiosk is open even when Baro isn't there, so bank Ducats ahead of his visit; his window is only 48 hours.
Bronze parts are worth 15 ducats, silver 45, gold 100 (25/65 for parts downgraded from vaulted relics); 490 is about five gold parts.
bonuses: Short fissures (Capture, Exterminate) crack relics fastest; a four-person squad on the same relic era earns roughly 80% more Ducats than solo since everyone gets their own reward pick.
Sell every spare Prime part rather than farming from zero.

disclosures.title: where not to get ducats
disclosures.body: Void Surplus is a trap for this: 50,000 credits for a 2% chance at 1,000 ducats. Aya to Ducats at Varzia is 5 ducats per Aya, an extremely poor rate. Both are last resorts only.

groups.activity: buy the Prisma Dual Cleavers outright
groups.meta: stock rotates irregularly, several visits a year

rows.label: Prisma Dual Cleavers
rows.note: arrives built and ready to equip; no Foundry step
rows.alt: or a TennoCon relay visit with Baro's Relay Ticket

conditions: Baro's stock changes every visit; the Cleavers aren't guaranteed even when he is. Type `when baro` in Region or Relay chat, or check a Ducat Kiosk countdown, to see which relay he's visiting.
MR 9 is needed to equip it, and to receive it in a trade.
His "leaving soon" message goes out 10 hours before he leaves; he's typically gone by Sunday morning Eastern.

disclosures.title: why it's still worth grabbing
disclosures.body: It's a crit-focused Dual Swords with high crit and status, using the exclusive Justice Blades syndicate augment. It's a crowded weapon class and not a top pick, but it's cheap in Ducats and a buy-on-sight for the Mastery.
